mapper.select: SELECT * FROM customer_type_price WHERE customer_type_id = #{customerTypeId} AND deleted = FALSE AND effective_from <= #{at} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > #{at}) AND sku_id IN #{id} ORDER BY effective_from DESC, id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_type_price WHERE customer_type_id = #{customerTypeId} AND sku_id = #{skuId} AND deleted = FALSE AND id != #{id} AND effective_from < COALESCE(#{to}, 'infinity'::timestamptz) AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > #{from})
SELECT id FROM customer_type WHERE id = #{customerTypeId} AND deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_type_price SET deleted = TRUE, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = 'SYSTEM' WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = FALSE
